summary: usb_latency_test.sh with builds of usbstamp_hosttest.c whose faults in private copies of the recorder and the scheduler make the checker refuse every record

argv: exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${SRC}/rach2/sys -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I rach2/sys/usb tests/host/usbstamp_hosttest.c -o ${WORK}/usbstamp_hosttest

faults.name: cutoff
faults.summary: the recorder gives no record when it is read more than 20 ms after the wake

lines: usb-latency-test: fail: the host test exits 1
usb-latency-test: fail: verdict: spin: the checker refuses
usb-latency-test: fail: verdict: timer beside getrandom: the checker refuses
usb-latency-test: fail: verdict: random: the checker refuses
